teaser: Anthropic's five primitives for always-on agents, set beside the around 250 named agents six of us ran at Web Summit, and the next problems once there are many.
core_idea: William Hu's Building always-on agents (Anthropic, 13 November 2026) rests on five primitives: event inbox, timers, memory, permissions and outbox. The Web Summit team built the same five for around 250 named agents from git, files, vaults and keys; the comparison shows where they agree, where the team got it wrong, and the next problems a team meets: agents starting agents, identity, stopping, many humans, observability and governance.
